title: N-1 and N-2 (Japanese) domains
statement: Let $R$ be an integral domain with field of fractions $K$. (1) $R$ is *N-1* if the integral closure of $R$ in $K$ [def-weil-pbc-integral-closure] is a finitely generated $R$-module [def-weil-finitely-generated-module]. (2) $R$ is *N-2*, or *Japanese*, if for every finite field extension $L/K$ [def-pc-field-extension] (i.e. $\dim_KL<\infty$) the integral closure of $R$ in $L$ is a finitely generated $R$-module. Taking $L=K$ shows that an N-2 domain is N-1.
